posts.name: GURUKUMAR K C
posts.cooked:
So, I see that there is weekly assignment and programming assignments. But in Week0 video they give instructions on logging in through VM for submitting assignments.

So if I submit the programming assignments, should I still submit the assignments through the VM?

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: No. The weekly programming assignments are to be submitted on the portal. On the VM, you will gets BPTs.

posts.name: GURUKUMAR K C
posts.cooked:
So should we not solve assignments 1 to 10 and practice questions listed in the directory?
Also I am unable to create a script.sh for assignment_1. I have the script in script.sh but when running synchro eval, I am getting the following error

File /home/24f1001225/se2001/assignment_1/script.sh is not executable

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked:
1. Those are for your practice and will not be used for grading.

  2. Please make the file executable by using chmod +x script.sh

    • chmod is the command used for changing file permissions.
    • +x makes the file executable.
    • script.sh is your filename.
